Live - Khamenei grants 'certain authority' for US peace talks, Pezeshkian says (Iran International liveblog)
Entries dated Monday 2 November 2026 (GMT):

17:08 GMT - Pezeshkian on talks: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated that Supreme Leader Khamenei had granted the government "certain authorities" regarding peace discussions with Washington.
16:27 GMT - Russia's diplomatic push: Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova indicated Russia was "ready to help negotiate and implement mutually acceptable solutions to the crisis." (Search snippet: "We consider it necessary to step up diplomatic work to normalize the situation")
15:16 GMT - Defence spending call: Lawmakers urged increased military funding under the nation's "current wartime conditions," with committee spokesman Hassan Ghashghavi emphasizing support for armed forces' operational needs (meeting with Ali Abdollahi, chief of Iran's Armed Forces General Staff).
14:42 GMT - Paramilitary expansion: Revolutionary Guards commander Hassan Hassanzadeh announced formation of the first Janfada brigade, reporting that "more than 33 million Iranians had expressed willingness to participate."
14:30 GMT - Hormuz reopening: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated the Strait would reopen if the United States accepted Tehran's conditions, describing mediator consultations (through Qatari and Pakistani mediators) as "very intense." Araghchi said Tehran was discussing a proposal that could allow the Strait of Hormuz to reopen within two days if Washington met Iranian conditions.
14:05 GMT - Putin-Rezaei call: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei discussed Middle East developments with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Also (search snippet): Saudi Arabia announced that its air defenses had intercepted and destroyed two drones in the Riyadh region on Monday, amid renewed missile and drone attacks by Yemen's Iran-supported Houthis on Saudi territory.
